text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Miracle. So, today... is your birthday.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah. You remembered, huh?<n>Thanks... Um,
Zephyr, what's that in<n>your hand?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's for your birthday. I wanted to giveyou the thing I love most... Mypresent to you is wind.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Haha, that's such a soft,<n>gentle wind! Thank
you for such a<n>wonderful present, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, we always get along very<n>well, so I felt
comfortable taking<n>things in a different direction for
your<n>birthday.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I went a little too far and... tried telling<n>a joke. But
you genuinely<n>appreciated it instead. Hehe...
Hehehe. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'm sorry! Did I, um... do<n>something wrong?
Was I supposed<n>to make a comeback?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, your response was so... you.<n>That's why I felt
the urge to try<n>something new, Miracle. Hehehe...
